notes.title: Switching From Paid to Free
notes.content: Thank you to everyone who purchased Moose Invasion and supported it through this page. This was a learning experience and a lot of fun. I have broken even with my investment and plan to switch this store page from paid to free in about a week. There will be no refunds for already purchased copies of the game. You can follow the Moose Invasion community page for updates on future projects.

notes.title: Achievements Now Available
notes.content: I have had some issues getting steam achievements to work but they are now online. Apologies for the inconvenience.
